parameters.name: conn_id
parameters.description: Airflow connection ID for the IBM MQ instance. Defaults to ``"mq_default"``.

parameters.name: queue_manager
parameters.description: Name of the IBM MQ queue manager to connect to. If not provided, the value is read from the ``queue_manager`` key in the connection's *extra* JSON.

parameters.name: channel
parameters.description: MQ channel name used for the connection. If not provided, the value is read from the ``channel`` key in the connection's *extra* JSON.

parameters.name: open_options
parameters.description: Integer bitmask of ``MQOO_*`` open options passed when opening a queue (e.g., ``ibmmq.CMQC.MQOO_INPUT_SHARED | ibmmq.CMQC.MQOO_FAIL_IF_QUIESCING``). If not provided, the value is resolved from the ``open_options`` key in the connection's *extra* JSON, falling back to ``MQOO_INPUT_SHARED``.

parameters.name: mq_conn_id
parameters.description: Airflow connection id for the IBM MQ broker.

parameters.name: queue_name
parameters.description: Name of the IBM MQ queue to consume from.

parameters.name: poll_interval
parameters.description: Seconds between MQ get attempts inside the hook.

parameters.name: open_options
parameters.description: Optional integer bitmask of MQOO_* flags for queue open.
